results.references: - Zijian Liu. [Random Reshuffling Dominates Stochastic Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/html/2606.32005v1). 2026 (preprint v1, 30 June). Complexity: $O\!\left(n+\frac{L_{\max}R^2}{\varepsilon}+\min\left\{\frac{\sigma^2R^2}{\varepsilon^2},\frac{\sqrt{nL_{\mathrm{avg}}}\,\sigma R^2}{\varepsilon^{3/2}}\right\}\right)$ exact component-gradient oracle calls, with fixed cost, for constant-step random reshuffling achieving expected objective gap at most $\varepsilon$ at an averaged output.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x) = (1/n)∑ᵢ fᵢ(x), with every component convex and a minimizer x⋆ satisfying ‖x₀−x⋆‖ ≤ R.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: There are n ≥ 1 component functions on a complete real Hilbert space E.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every reply is the exact component gradient, for every call index and oracle seed. There is no oracle error.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query specifies a component index i and a point x; one oracle call returns ∇fᵢ(x).

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: At a minimizer satisfying the initial-distance bound, (1/n)∑ᵢ ‖∇fᵢ(x⋆)‖² ≤ σ². This bounds component-gradient heterogeneity at that minimizer, without imposing a uniform variance bound elsewhere.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Component gradients have Lipschitz constants ℓᵢ ≥ 0 with ℓᵢ ≤ Lmax and (1/n)∑ᵢ ℓᵢ ≤ Lavg. Valid parameters satisfy 0 < Lavg ≤ Lmax, R ≥ 0, σ ≥ 0, and ε > 0. Algorithms are restricted to reshuffledGradient with a positive constant step size. All Params, including E, n, Lavg, Lmax, R, σ, ε, and x₀, are public; the component functions are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ReshuffledSmoothConvex.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/ConstantStepReshuffledSmoothConvex.lean: spec.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output is the final point of the permitted constant-step reshuffledGradient algorithm. Its objective gap F(output)−F(x⋆) must be integrable and have expectation at most ε; the output must be measurable.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation under the product of the algorithm and oracle seed laws. The oracle-call budget is fixed and bounded for every seed.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex finite-sum optimization with exact component gradients, random reshuffling, heterogeneity measured at a minimizer, and expected objective-gap accuracy is an established formulation.
